worldcombat.skill.pounce.summary: Leap high from a distance and arc through the air onto the target: the falling weight presses it down and the legs immediately cling to it, dragging it to a halt, resolving only the first body met. The user stays beside the target. A clinging pounce lasts longer and cuts deeper Speed for a lighter blow.
worldcombat.skill.pounce.description.0: A pounce resolves against the first living non-ally it meets in the air: landing on it deals about %1$s physical damage and lowers its Speed stat by %2$s stages (other combatants get it on their movement speed); meeting nothing is a miss.
worldcombat.skill.pounce.description.1: One pounce reaches %1$s blocks, moving %2$s blocks per tick, with a %3$s block air hit radius.
worldcombat.skill.pounce.description.2: The grip lasts %1$s s; a heavy body or a clinging pounce also pins the legs for %2$s s, during which the target cannot move.
worldcombat.skill.pounce.cling.on: Clinging: a longer grip, one more Speed stage and a longer leg pin, at the cost of a lighter blow and longer recovery and cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.pounce.cling.off: Kick-off: a heavier, crisper pounce with a very short grip and quicker recovery.
worldcombat.skill.pounce.timing: Range %1$s blocks; %2$s s preparation, %3$s s recovery, %4$s PP, %5$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.pounce.growth.0: From level %1$s the pounce rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.pounce.growth.1: From level %1$s the pounce rises to %2$s and the grip lasts %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.pounce.use.0: Leap from mid range and stick to the target
worldcombat.skill.pounce.use.1: Cling first, then finish with a heavier move
worldcombat.skill.pounce.preference.clin: On: a longer grip, one more Speed stage and a longer leg pin, at the cost of a lighter blow and longer recovery and cooldown. Off: a heavier, crisper kick-off pounce with a very short grip.
worldcombat.skill.pounce.preference.ai.m: It closes in before pouncing beyond this distance. Larger values leap from further out.
worldcombat.skill.pounce.preference.ai.p: On: rank targets already carrying the clung identity last, so it grabs a fresh one. Off: treat it as an ordinary melee candidate.
world_combat.move.pounce.text.miss: The pounce missed and landed aside
